title: Utopia Design Protocol - component manifest
description: Machine-readable API registry of a utopia_ui release, a consumer project's custom components (project manifest), or the merged view of both. Components are concrete widgets (library: exported from the barrel; project: opt-in via overlay), plus models (data classes used in props) and helpers (functions, hooks, typedefs). Modeled on custom-elements-manifest, adapted to Flutter. Protocol version 0.3.0; see protocol/VERSIONING.md and SPEC.md 3.8.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest schema (the protocol version) this document conforms to.

package.description: The Dart package this manifest describes: "utopia_ui" for the shipped library manifest, the project's package name for project and merged manifests (SPEC 3.8).

packageVersion.description: Version of the described package, stamped from pubspec.yaml at generation time. For the library manifest it MUST match the consumer's resolved utopia_ui version (drift gate).

utopiaUiVersion.description: The resolved utopia_ui version this document was generated against. REQUIRED on project and merged manifests (SPEC 3.8 freshness gate); absent on the library manifest itself.

merged.description: True on the derived merged view (library + project components in one file). Merged manifests are regenerated, never edited, never a source of truth (SPEC 3.8).

kebabId.description: Component id: bare kebab-case for utopia_ui library components; '<packageName>:<kebab-name>' for project components (SPEC 3.3).

portableType.description: Portable prop type vocabulary (SPEC.md 3.5). The verbatim Dart type always travels alongside in dartType.

dartType.description: Verbatim Dart type of the parameter, e.g. "void Function(String?)".

default.description: Verbatim Dart default expression, e.g. "false", "const []". Absent when the parameter has no default.

enumName.description: For type "enum": the Dart enum's name.

values.description: For type "enum": the enum's value names.

itemType.description: For type "list": portable type of the list elements.

itemDartType.description: For type "list": verbatim Dart type of the list elements.

modelName.description: For type "model" (or list of models): the referenced entry in the models section.

name.description: Named-constructor name; empty string for the unnamed constructor.

tokenBindingPath.description: Dotted UtopiaThemeData member path the component reads, e.g. "colors.primary", "tokens.durations.xs", "theme.borderRadius".

tokenBindingOrigin.description: Provenance of the binding (SPEC 3.6): "source" = derived from the component's own Dart implementation by the extractor; "overlay" = declared by the overlay's tokenBindingsAdd escape hatch, which the extractor cannot see. Optional: documents written for an older minor carry bare-string bindings with no provenance at all, and a generator that cannot tell the two apart must be able to stay silent rather than guess. Every generator in this repo stamps it (SPEC 3.7), which is what lets validate_manifest verify a shipped manifest's bindings without the overlay directory the pub tarball does not ship.

tokenBinding.description: One tokenBindings entry. Since protocol 0.3.0 an object carrying the dotted path plus its origin; the bare-string form written by 0.2 generators stays valid (VERSIONING.md: documents written for an older minor remain valid) and is read as a path of unknown origin.

id.description: Stable id: class name minus the Utopia prefix, kebab-cased. Unique across the manifest.

generic.description: True when the widget is generic over a row/item type T.

composes.description: Ids of other manifest components this component renders internally.

twin.description: Where this component is rendered in the HTML twin (SPEC 4.4). Emitted by the generator exactly for the ids that carry a data-utopia-id section in the twin bundle; absent for components with no twin section.

file.description: Twin-bundle-relative file name (SPEC 4.1 layout), e.g. "components.html" - resolved against the twin/ directory of the package the manifest describes.

selector.description: CSS selector for the component's root element in that file, e.g. "[data-utopia-id=\"button\"]".

examples.description: Repo-relative paths demonstrating the component (example app sections).

notes.description: Curated semantic notes from the overlay (usage guidance an analyzer cannot derive).

kind.description: Dart declaration kind. Sealed hierarchies list subtypes as separate model entries whose supertype names the sealed parent.

supertype.description: For subtypes of a sealed hierarchy: the sealed parent's name.
